purpose: Immutable MaterialState payload for one accepted Schedule Movement Policy revision.

columns.name: schedule_ref
columns.meaning: Accepted Schedule governed by this policy state.

columns.name: automatic_movement_code
columns.meaning: Whether automation may attempt a governed move.

columns.name: acceptance_path_code
columns.meaning: Acceptance path required when automatic movement is enabled.
columns.value_contract: One of direct,confirmation_required; blocked policy requires direct.

primary_key.name: pk_schedule_movement_policy_state
primary_key.reason: One immutable policy payload per MaterialStateRef.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_movement_policy_state_material_state_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind the policy revision to shared MaterialState addressing.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_movement_policy_state_schedule
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind policy history to the accepted Schedule it governs.

unique_constraints.name: uq_schedule_movement_policy_state_schedule_material
unique_constraints.reason: Provide exact Schedule plus state integrity target for history and receipts.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_movement_policy_state_automatic_movement
check_constraints.reason: Bound automatic movement governance to the B04-D codes.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_movement_policy_state_blocked_shape
check_constraints.reason: A blocked policy cannot manufacture a pending confirmation path.

triggers.name: ctrg_schedule_movement_policy_state_totality
triggers.reason: Require one exact schedule.movement_policy MaterialState envelope and exclude cross-family payloads.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Each accepted policy revision is immutable MaterialState truth.
state_history.current_binding: Current policy is selected by the sole open schedule_movement_policy_current_history episode.
state_history.chronology: History timestamps, not MaterialStateRef order, define accepted chronology.
state_history.immutability_policy: Revision appends a new state; prior policy payloads are not rewritten.

lifecycle.retention: Retain policy states for reconstructible governance history.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime delete; retirement closes currentness without erasing prior policy states.

obligations: Movement Policy remains distinct from Schedule placement and Temporal Constraint
blocked/automatic and acceptance-path shape are bounded
